item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena has a sore throat and fever. Her mother wants to give her leftover antibiotic tablets from an earlier illness. The doctor advises against this. Why should antibiotics be taken only when a doctor prescribes them for a bacterial infection?

options.A: Antibiotics work against every infection, so taking them early always cures the illness faster.
options.B: Antibiotics kill bacteria, and careless use can let resistant bacteria develop, making future infections harder to treat.
options.C: Antibiotics first act on the throat and then on the stomach, so they must be taken with food.
options.D: Antibiotics become stronger each time they are used, so frequent use keeps them powerful.
